# pvecli pool list

List all resource pools.

```text
pvecli pool list [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Description |
|:--|:--|
| `-p`, `--profile VALUE` | Profile to use. |
| `-o`, `--order VALUE` | Sort by column (moved to first position), e.g. pool, comment. |
| `-js`, `--json` | Output raw JSON to stdout (no colors, no tables). |
